notes: family: race-to-goal. Pillbox Games card game (BGG 230765, 2-8 players); not Goliath 'May Cause Side Effects' (different game). No scoring: game ends when one player has treated every disorder in their psyche. Official rulebook not retrievable (Pillbox rules page removed, BGG files need login); objective confirmed by publisher page + BGG description only, so detailed edge cases (treatment via Therapy/Placebo, simultaneous finish) unverified. Booster Shot and Hex Effects excluded. Record only winner.
winCondition: First player to treat every disorder in their psyche (with drugs or therapy) wins; the game ends immediately.

endCondition.description: A player treats all disorders in their psyche.
